instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Open a page in a window of its own in my browser and keep it for my next steps", and give it the input.
2. The AI calls do_one_thing_in_my_account at @tools with method tools:run, tool tool:drive-my-browser and its input (the worked example shows one).
3. Read what comes back: the page's answer in result, or error in words when no browser is connected to your computer, when the door has no key set up, or when the page could not be read.
